parameters.query:
SELECT s.id AS staff_id, s.full_name AS staff_name, s.email AS staff_email, s.role, s.current_load, s.telegram_chat_id,
       d.id AS department_id, d.name AS department_name, d.code AS department_code
FROM staff s
JOIN departments d ON s.department_id = d.id
WHERE s.department_id = {{ $json.department_id }} AND s.active = 1
ORDER BY s.current_load ASC, s.id ASC
LIMIT 1;
